svg.title: Category editor states
svg.desc: Opening a row starts editing. Save enters an in-flight state, where duplicate saves and cancellation are blocked. Failure returns to editing with the selection; confirmed success closes the editor and refreshes data.

html:div.html:span: 11. Block duplicate saves; Escape cannot cancel an in-flight request

g.data-value: One row can be edited at a time. Cancel applies before submission; a failed save keeps the selected category.
